**Findings triage: promoted → `pm:queue`, routed `domain:devx`** (route repair + grading in one pass; the second unrouted finding from the 12:20Z brief).

**Premise verified on `origin/main` @ `8a9c079`**:
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` exists; its parser already captures the `--filter` package (`:66` — `for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/pnpm\s+(?:--filter\s+(\S+)\s+)?(?:run\s+)?(check:[\w:-]+)/g))`), so the invocation prefix is parsed and then dropped at the print site, exactly as the card says.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` confirmed present (the gate the two devs concluded was nonexistent).

**Routing rationale** — `scripts/pm/**` is PM/dev tooling ⇒ `domain:devx`, same call as #7412 (per the #5469 ruling: general dev-tooling face stays `devx`; this tool is not spec-contract-facing).

**Promotion rationale** — concrete scoped tooling fix, fully specified at the print site (emit the runnable `pnpm --filter <pkg> run check:*` line the parser already holds), with a measured cost: two independent devs (PR #7416, PR #7417) discarded a real gate as nonexistent within one hour, from the tool's own output. Cheap fix, credibility-class damage when unfixed. No `target:v17` (internal tooling).

**Dedup** — #7412 is the same directory but a different script (`check-half-states.mjs` reachability); no card owns dispatch-gates output format.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Implemented in draft PR **#7551**, packed with #7488 on branch `claude/issue-7488-7440-pm-tooling`. **The full `os-dev` report lives on #7488** — https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/7488#issuecomment-5249247958

This card's half in one line: the matched-gate print site now emits the runnable invocation from the `--filter` package the parser at `:66` already captured — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` instead of the bare name, with root-scoped checks printing `pnpm check:*` unchanged, and a direct-node check printing `node scripts/check-x.mjs` (the one shape the card did not name; `pnpm scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` would have been a new wrong answer). Formatting only, no new discovery logic; the self-test's `--filter` sample line now drives the print site too, so the sample workflow and the printed form cannot drift apart.

Verified by running the tool on a `content/docs/` path — real before/after output in the PR body — and then running both halves for real. The printed line exits 0; the bare name a dev would try answers:

```
 ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL  Command "check:doc-formula-expressions" not found

Did you mean "pnpm check:doc-authoring"?
```

That is this card's incident reproduced end to end — and pnpm's own suggestion is precisely the gate #7245's dev substituted (PR #7417's report: *"nearest existing doc-corpus gate check:doc-authoring was run instead"*). The tool was sending two independent readers down a path pnpm itself pointed at.

The dev reproduced the original incident end to end: the bare name fails with `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL` and pnpm's own "did you mean check:doc-authoring" suggestion is exactly the wrong substitution #7245's dev made. Self-tests pin all three shapes against the same workflow fixtures the parser reads, so print site and sample cannot drift apart.
